This area is only accessible after mining the red sandstone wall.

scene_description: A sandstone temple structure on a sand plain. The player spawns near a path of smooth sandstone slabs leading to a wide entrance. Inside the temple, the main room has smooth sandstone slab flooring. The back wall is made entirely of red sandstone walls, which when mined reveals a hidden chamber behind containing a stone pressure plate on the floor, lit by a torch. The progression is: find smooth sandstone slabs (landmark/path) → enter building → mine red sandstone wall → discover stone pressure plate.

Stone pressure plate at ~5,0,11 on the floor of the hidden chamber. Back wall at z=11 is sandstone (sealed) with torch at ~4,2,11 for lighting. Roof covers both rooms.
